decisions: | R-next | 2026-11-01 | Turn-end delivery drains the existing queue and reports to the parent through one shared, idempotent path regardless of automatic checks. Keep all existing completion paths; a per-reply live receipt and the parent's saved report id prevent duplicate delivery during checks, compaction and interrupted-turn recovery. No new process, timer or stored conversation field. | AI |

fixed.en: Queued messages and child reports continue after a turn ends, even when no checks run.
fixed.pt-BR: As mensagens na fila e os relatórios dos agentes seguem quando o turno termina, mesmo sem verificações.
fixed.es: Los mensajes en espera y los informes de los agentes siguen al terminar el turno, aunque no se ejecuten comprobaciones.
fixed.fr: Les messages en attente et les comptes rendus des agents suivent la fin du tour, même sans vérification.
fixed.de: Nach dem Ende eines Durchgangs werden wartende Nachrichten und Berichte der Agenten weitergegeben, auch wenn keine Prüfungen laufen.
